title: Synthetic fixture: payment released seven days after an unverified bank-detail change
summary: SYNTHETIC. Constructed to demonstrate the incident-to-rule workflow. It is not a real, verified or suppressed incident, and it describes no real organisation or person.

steps.text: Change request CR-0042 updated SYN-V-001's remittance account on 2026-03-02; its callback verification field is blank.
Payment SYN-PAY-001 (48000.00 CAD) was released on 2026-03-09 to the account on file at that time.
Vendor SYN-V-001 is the payee of record. The evidence does not establish who submitted the change request.
Sequence: change request on 2026-03-02, then payment release on 2026-03-09, seven days later.
No callback record or telephone log is available to show whether the change was verified.
A public notice attributed to the vendor says its banking arrangements did not change in Q1 2026, which conflicts with the change request.
Analyst assumption: the account change and the payment relate to the same remittance account.
